content: Peter le John Te Kiman
Amate in mipite tungah thu a hil uh laitak in, thiampi te, biakinn lampui te le Sadducee te amate kungah hongpai uh hi,
Sawltak te in mipi te thuhil a, Jesus tungtawn in thina pan thawkikna thu a pualak uh hu in, amate thinna in om tek uh hi.
Taciang amate in sawltak te man uh a, a zingciang dong thongtaksak uh hi: banghangziam cile tu in khua niam zo hi.
Ahihang a thuhilna a zate in um uh hi; a umte a mimal in tul nga kiim pha uh hi.
Peter in Israel Upa te Tung Thuson
A zingciang in amate i lampui te, upa te le thukhamhil te,
Taciang thiampi sang Annas le Caiaphas, John le Alexander, taciang thiampi sang i mealheak te theampo taw Jerusalem ah ki kaikhawm tek uh hi.
Amate a laizang ah dingsak uh a, bang thuneina, a hibale akua min taw in hibang te vawt nu ziam? ci dong hi.
Tuazawkciang in Peter sia Thaa Thiangtho taw kidim a, amate tung ah, no mipi lampui te le Israel upa te,
Tuni in hi cina pa tungah napha a ki vawtna le banghang in dam, ci thu taw kisai in thu hong dong nahi uh le;
Note theampo le Israel mi theampo in he tavun, thinglamte tungah na khai uh a, Pathian in thina pan a thawkiksak Nazareth mi Jesus Christ min taw, note mai ah a ding pa sia dam hi.
Noma inn sate in na nil uh hi suangtum sia inn khuampi suak hi.
Ngupna sia mundang ah om ngawl hi; banghangziam cile ngupna i nga thei natu in vantung leinuai ah mindang a kipia om ngawl hi, ci hi.
Jesus Min Taw Thuhil tu Kham
Amate in Peter le John te hangsanna a mu uh ciang in, lai he ngawl le pilna nei ngawl te, ci he uh a, lamdangsa mama uh hi; taciang amate sia Jesus taw omkhawm ngei hi, ci zong he kik uh hi.
Taciang a damsak pa sia amate taw a dingkhawm nginge a mu uh hu in, tua thu langpan in bangma a pau thei bua uh hi.
Amate thuneite kungpan pusuak tu in thu a piak zawk uh ciang, amate bek thu kikum khawm uh a,
Hite banglaw tu hi ziam? banghangziam cile amate in a cepte tak nalamdang te vawt uh a, Jerusalem ah a om mi theampo mai ah vawt uh hi; taciang hi thu i nial thei bua hi.
Ahihang hi thu mite sungah kizel thua ngawl tu in ahizong, kuama tungah hi min taw thuhil ngawl tu ahizong, nasiatak in thawmvau tawng, ci uh hi.
Taciang amate sam uh a, Jesus min taw thuhil ngawlhet tu le son nawn ngawl tu in thupia uh hi.
Ahihang Peter le John in, Pathian thu sang in note i thu man tu sia Pathian mai ah a pha le a phangawl noma in khensat vun.
Banghangziam cile ka mu uh thu le ka zak uh thu te son ngawl in ka om thei bua uh hi, ci in zo uh hi.
Tua ahikom amate in a thawmvau zawk uh ciang in, bangbang in danpia tu ci a heak ngawl uh hu in suatak uh hi, banghangziam cile mi theampo in hi a sep uh te hang in Pathian minthang pok tek uh hi.
Banghangziam cile hi cidamna nalamdang a tungah a kilangpa sia kum sawm li val zo hi.
Hangsantak In Thungen
A suatak zawk uh ciang, amate a lawmte kungah pai uh a, thiampi lian te le upa te in amate tungah a son theampo sonkik uh hi.
Tua thu amate in a zak uh ciang in, thinkhat lung khat in Pathian kungah au tek uh a, Topa awng, Nangma sia van le lei, tuipi le a sung om theampo a vawt Pathian na hihi:
Na naseam David tungtawn a son thu, banghang in Gentile mite thin-uk ziam, taciang mihing te banghang in matlap nei ngawl thu te ngaisun uh ziam?
Leitung kumpi te ding uh a, taciang ngam uk te zong ki kaikhawm in Topa le Christ langpan uh hi.
Banghangziam cile sathau na buaksa Nangma i a thiangtho nauno Jesus sia Herod le Pontius Pilate, Gentile mite le Israel mite taw, ki kaikhawm tek in, nasiatak in langpan uh hi,
Banghangziam cile na khut taw na vawt tu te le na khensatsa ngaisutna te na khuangkhim natu a hihi.
Tu in Topa awng, amate i hong thawmnvauna te en in: na sal te tungah na thu pualak tu in hangsanna hongpia tan,
Na nauno thiangtho Jesus min taw cina te damsak tu le musakna te le nalamdang te vawt tu in na ban hong phal ta in, ci in thungen khawm uh hi.
Amate thu a nget zawk uh ciang in, a kikhopna mun ling hi; taciang amate sia Tha Thiangtho taw kidim uh a, Pathian thu hangsantak in son uh hi.
Na Theampo Neikhawm
Taciang thu um mihonpi te thinkhat lungkhat taw in omkhawm tek uh hi: kuama in a neisa te uh keima a hi, ci ngawl uh hi; ahihang amate neisa na theampo neikhawm tek uh hi.
Topa Jesus thawkikna thu ssawltak te in vangletna lianpi taw tettipang uh a: amate tungah hesuakna lianpi om hi.
Amate sungah a ki tangsam khat zong a om bua uh hi: banghangziam cile lo ngam te, a hibale inn nei te in zuak uh hi, taciang a sum nga uh teng keng uh a,
Sawltak te peang ah koi tek uh hi: taciang khatsim i kisapna bang in hawm uh hi.
Taciang Joses, sawltak te in Barnabas a ci uh, Barnabas i a khiakna sia, henepna tapa a kici pa, ama sia Levi minam hi a, Cyprus ngam mi a hihi,
Tua pa in a lo zuak a, a dangka keng in, sawltak te peang ah koi hi.
